reviews.text: First time at Southpaw Vet and I’m so impressed by the professionalism and compassion the team has. My cat Rocky is such an anxious boy and Erika, Evelyn and Dr.Moss were so gentle and loving. They educated me on Rocky’s treatment and answered all my silly questions. Thank you all so much for your help! I’m glad I found you guys. :)

I love this vet office! It’s clean, easy to get an appointment, everyone is friendly and helpful. We’ve seen multiple vets here and they always provide excellent care without being judgey. One time I was extremely late to an appointment because I just couldn’t get out of work in time. Dr. Mulqueen and the team stayed late (even after they closed) so that my pup could still get seen because they could hear how worried I was. They were extremely gracious and kind with their time and Dr. Mulqueen was very thoughtful with his recommendations and analysis and would love to have either of my pups see him again.

When I moved to this area last year I started using Southpaw for convenience. I loved how it never took more than a couple days to get in to see the doctor and the staff is great. What made this place especially amazing was how they took care of us when our 14 1/2  year old poodle mix started to decline. His dementia was really starting to take a toll on all of us and his quality of life severely declined. The advice and care we received was gentle, calm, and assuring. We made the decision to say our last goodbye and everyone there, with a special shout out to Jessica, made this as smooth a process as possible. I miss my boy every day, but I will always be grateful to Southpaw for the genuine care they provided for us.

I sadly no longer come to Southpaw simply bc I moved out of the San Diego area but this clinic has been the best I’ve taken my animals too by far. It always clean, areas regularly disinfected, and staff is always very welcoming and the owner is a great person. I have a nervous bully and every visit the staff is accommodating and extremely patient and most importantly understanding and aware of how to approach these situations to reduce negative experiences. The pricing is a bit high, I would say industry standard, but with past experience most treatment plans, medicinal and general care recommended to us has been reasonable. I don’t feel as if they recommend more just to gain profit.

Dr. Yonas, Dr. Mayne, and all of the vets, vet techs and front desk staff at Southpaw are the best of the best. We started taking our girls to Southpaw shortly after they opened and never had one regret. Through some really sick and hard times, they guided us through. We unfortunately moved out of area, but we still really miss this place. Thanks for everything, Southpaw family. 🤍
Awesome professional service!

This vet office is phenomenal for our 2 cats! 🐈🐈‍⬛Their communication is thorough and clear, and the providers are all very knowledgeable and friendly. They can often get us in within a timely manner, and have been accommodating with schedule changes. The vet office is clean and cute as well. We could not recommend this office more! 🐾

Are you looking for a vet office who REALLY CARES about your pet?

Who isn’t trying to upsell and profit off ur sick pet?

Who does  what they say they are going to do?

Who are kind and compassionate and thorough.

Who really take the time to educate you on your pets condition.

Look no further babies!  Have your dog parents take you here. Parking is great too! Always a plus in SD!

In a word full of veterinarian offices  who don’t really care about ur pet and just out to make a buck. I’m so pleased I found South Paw. Thank you for your continued Kindness. Compassion and Integrity!

So nice, so positive, so attentive, everyone you interacted with felt that they cared about your most precious family member. They talk through options with you and are honest about timelines and needs versus wants.  After his vaccinations, my pup came back with a happy face and a little bandana  They’ll absolutely be seeing my little guy again when he needs a Vet
Too expensive compared to bigger companies
Always a great experience with each staff member we've encountered.

Reposting since my original review was removed. I brought my dog here for his vaccines as my first vet after moving to San Diego, which was already scary since he had been seeing the same vet for as long as I’d had him up to this point. For reference, he’s a 10 pound chihuahua who was completely healthy. The vet had asked me if I would like to give him all of his vaccines at once, or if I’d like to split them into separate appointments. I really didn’t know what was and wasn’t ok (I learned afterwards that a dog his size should have never received that many vaccines at once) so I trusted the vet. I told her that for convenience I’d like to keep it in one appointment but that I also didn’t mind bringing him back if they needed to be split up. She said she thought it was fine, and they took him to the back. When they brought him out to me afterwards, he immediately looked very off, I asked the vet tech if he was alright. She dismissed me by saying “we did a lot today so he probably won’t be feeling his best.” As I was holding him trying to check out I could hear him making a gurgling noise and labored breathing. I kept being dismissed whenever I said I didn’t think he was ok. Finally I said that I wanted the vet to look at him to make sure. After a couple hours of keeping him in the back again, they told me he had thrown up during his vaccines and they thought it was possible he had aspirated. They kept him until closing, gave me a list of things to look out for and told me to take him to the emergency vet if any of these things happened, one being vomiting, which he did the minute we got home. I took him to VSH (who I had an incredible experience with) they confirmed that he did aspirate and that he also had pneumonia. They also confirmed that a dog his size should have never received that many vaccines in one appointment. He was in the animal ICU for about 5 days in an oxygen chamber so that he could breathe as well as put on multiple rounds of antibiotics until his pneumonia finally responded. He is ok now, praise God. I really don’t leave reviews, especially negative ones, but I never want anyone else or their pet to have to experience something like this, emotionally or financially.
Great service. Performed surgery on our cat and gave multiple updates after requested. Great communication and staff.

Both of my dogs have received excellent care here at Southpaw Vet. I would say the care is expensive, however I have found that good vet care is pretty expensive everywhere these days. I am low income, so the vets at Southpaw are always willing to work with me as far as giving me paper prescriptions so that I can fill them at Costco for a cheaper price, etc. I really appreciate that. Also if you have a new puppy they have a convenient puppy package that includes all the necessary vaccines and checks for a set price, cheaper than it would be if you purchased them all individually. In addition, every time I am there, everyone from the office staff to the vet technicians are all so friendly and kind. I'm really grateful for Southpaw Vet!
Southpaw Vet is the best choice for vet care in San Diego.

Thanks Juliana, Nicole, and the reception staff for their support and warm welcome to the neighborhood. I appreciate how they are quick to respond and follow up on pet parents' and their clients' needs. They helped book and manage the appointment schedule on phone, which was very helpful as a busy pet partner. They also helped record his past records, which gives pet parents peace of mind when transitioning primary vets, knowing that there is continuity of care and folks that understand that importance. I also want to thank Dr. Claire McCallick for her excellent care, comprehensive exams, and dedication to providing the best possible care and advice. She clearly understood my son's past history and examinations prior to our first appointment. I appreciated her taking the time to answer questions and offer advice on complex topics like dog nutrition and food. We transferred here this week after relocating from OC, and very much felt that the team here operates with professionalism with the furry family member's best interest at heart.  The will say that prices here may be a premium but I leave satisfied with the quality of care my son receives.

We absolutely love our visits with Dr. Mayne. She provides us with very helpful information and is very thorough. The staff is always so loving and passionate for the care they provide. You all are really the bet vet in San Diego! Thank you for caring for our furbaby!

Adding onto my other review, this is the really bad part. After over a month of giving him insulin and purchasing over $2,800 worth of stuff for him for appointments, medications, and new diet foods; he was getting worse. I called them and said something isn’t right the insulin seems to make him worse and I told them that he actually was a lot more energetic and happy when he wasn’t on insulin and that it’s changed him more and put a lot more pain in him. The doctor ended up calling a day later and saying  he must be the rarest cat to be in remission or he never had diabetes and so no insulin anymore and I understand it’s frustrating beings the costs and the insulin making him worse. I told her they should be refunding us for all the medications at the very least as we spend hundreds for the food and insulin and syringes we never needed to get. Also the fact that they are the reason my cat is in more pain to this day now because they had us giving insulin to my cat when he wasn’t even diabetic. Twice a day as well. They said they couldn’t do anything for us for refunds but could give us a complimentary app and testing done that should’ve been done in the beginning before diagnosing him fully with diabetes and or prescribing insulin for that matter. We told them to send us all his documents and call and text recordings and documents and that we are never going back. This vet will scam you for your money if you seem like you could be someone they could walk all over. It is SICKENING. To know what this place did to my baby that I’ve taken very good care of for 14 years now. Shame on all of you guys at southpaw vet. They then wanted to say at the end how they were so sorry and how they gave us discounts because we couldn’t afford everything meaning the demo for the insulin even though HE NEVER NEEDED INSULIN IN THE FIRST PLACE. SHAME ON ALL OF YOU.

If I could give 0 stars for this place I would. I have been to a lot of vets now even in different states where I lived before, and not any of them have done what this place has done. I’ve had my cat for 14 years, and he is my absolute whole world to me. My boyfriend and I brought him in a few months ago for his first appointment. Right off the bat this place had us spend over $1,300 to get a bunch of testings we didn’t even know what they were for. I was very clear and specific on his health history with his hypothyroidism and his symptoms and what’s been going on with him. They called us the next day and told me he has diabetes and that they were shocked with this news. I was as well as he’s never given signs of diabetes and I know what I feed my cat and his behaviors. They said he also has a heart murmur 2/5. They told us on the phone our options are to either put him down, (yes they legit told me over the phone if we couldn’t afford the costs as they are expensive for diabetes then we could euthanize him) we never ever were thinking that in the first place for an option as I knew he wasn’t sick like that. So they had us get insulin for him right off the bat, (lantus) which is also used for humans and then the syringes. They then had us pay over 150$ for his new dry food and wet food for diabetic cats. They then said we had to come in for a demo of how to give the insulin and that there is a charge of 90 some dollars to do it just for them to quickly show us how. The girl who showed us how to give it even told us in her own words “yeah you guys can easily watch how to do this too online like YouTube” but when we asked the doctor she said we had to come in to do it and can not look on any videos how. I told them that we just spent so much out of no where and could not afford that so they did the demo for free for us when the other worker even said yeah we could’ve looked that up online too instead of putting my cat through all of this hell. After giving insulin doses to him they had us do one unit twice a day he started getting more sick and wheezing more. We brought him in again and they said we should buy him the libre 3 plus device for his glucose readings. We bought that then had to come in for them to put that on him. One of the workers was holding him upward on his back feet on the spinny chair after putting the device on him and clearly saw how upset and scared he already was. The other worker then said you can go ahead and just set him down. Like why would they even put him on the spiny chair standing him up uncomfortably after knowing he’s drugged up and confused and scared? Also every single worker there except maybe two when weve seen a lot of doctors there at appointments who’ve came in for licorice have all called him a her and haven’t even looked at his documents whatsoever to even know the sex of the cat. I’ve also told them how old he is and how he gets gabapentin before apps because the car rides and vet make him puke and poop in the carrier all over himself. One of the workers opened the door so fast and knocked him over and then brushed it off like it was nothing. Unlike the other workers who’ve slowly opened the door and peaked behind to see if he was near it.
First visit was great! Very friendly staff, fast and reasonably priced.

Southpaw is an incredible vet practice. They have been so kind to us and helped us through an extremely emotional time with one of our cats. The entire team is so knowledgable and loving. I felt that Southpaw genuinely cares for my pets and treats them as they would their own. Southpaw has helped us through a lot in the last year and they were incredible. 100/10

Looking for quality, attentive, supportive, vet care? Look NO FURTHER. I am beyond grateful to have come across Southpaw Vet when I first moved to San Diego. I've been bringing my dog here for the past two years and have nothing but amazing things to say about all the staff here. Everyone is beyond friendly and makes sure pet parents are well-informed throughout their visit. All vets and techs are welcoming and create a warm, calm environment when attending to your pet. My dog has gone through a lot of issues this year and as you can imagine, has led to an overwhelming amount of bills, stress, and time off from work. Through it all, the team has continued to show me incredible support and reassurance, making each visit feel less daunting and more manageable. While their costs can sometimes be a bit higher than a typical vet, the value truly comes through in how they work with you, listen to your concerns, and go the extra mile to support both you and your pet.

I want to personally give a BIG shoutout to all the ladies at reception and Dr. Skinner, who are always so quick to respond to any questions, inquiries, or concerns. I truly don’t know how I would have kept it together without you all. Because of your support, I can make the best decisions for my dog with confidence and peace of mind.

I loved my experience at SouthPaw! My shepherd mix, Lola, had a cactus thorn stuck in her tongue and Dr. McCallick and Andrea took the best care of us! Yearly shots all administered and they made sure to make both me and Lola comfortable during the whole visit! Quick and easy scheduling and they were able to get us in next day!
they are literally the bestest. the staff are so friendly and always give the best service to my kitty. highly recommend to anyone in the SD area.
The dedication and compassion of everyone at Southpaw is unmatched. By far the best vet office we have ever experienced in San Diego!

Leo’s visit to Southpaw Vet was such a positive experience. The clinic was clean and welcoming, and the entire staff was so kind and attentive. It’s not often you find a vet where your pup actually enjoys being there, but this is definitely one of them!
Cannot recommend highly enough!

Love Southpaw Vet!  Dr Yonas ans his staff are so friendly and attentive. .I've been bringing my pets here for 4 heats and look forward to more!  All procedures ans visits are explained in detail and tou never feel rushed but they are so quick and efficient.  They rrally care about your furry family members I cannot recommend enough!!

I hate leaving a negative review for this place, because every visit (3 or 4 times) prior to my most recent one has only been a positive experience with professional staff and trustworthy vets.

However, I think it is important to call out what happened on my last visit, which was a follow-up on an ear infection for our almost 7-year old dog. This time I was helped by a vet I never met before.

The vet asked if he is on flee/tick/heartworm meds and I said “no” and that we had taken him off because we believed it had been causing hair loss on his back, leaving hairless spots, which have since resolved since taking him off.

I could tell she did not approve of this response, and proceeded to look at his fur and within a few seconds of examination proclaimed “oh, I found a flea. You need to put him back on the flea/tick/heartworm meds. That’s probably what’s causing the ear infections.” She then proceeded to recommend their very pricy medication to purchase directly from them.

I believe she LIED about this. We have never been able to find a flea on our dog, there is no evidence of flea bite marks, excessive scratching, visual confirmation of fleas on our end, EVER.  I asked the vet assistant to find one and show me after the vet left (I was too confused and the vet left too quick for me to ask her to show me directly) and the vet assistant could not find any.

To say that this is what is causing his ear infections, which directly contradicts what prior vets have told us the causes of his ear infections, (he has had prior ear infections while ON The meds no less) is extremely unprofessional and misleading.

In the event she was NOT lying, and he actually has fleas, she offered NO direction on how to handle the flea infestation besides “put him back on meds”. No recommendations for who to handle, cleaning him, managing an infestation, etc.

VERY disappointed with this place which sucks because I liked it a lot before this experience. For a place that charges a very high rate vs. competitors I would expect better.

From the moment you step through the doors, you feel the difference. Chloe and Nicole at reception are not just friendly—they’re organized, attentive, and make every visit feel effortless. Jessica, the vet assistant, is incredibly patient and gentle with my dog, taking the time to explain every step and making sure he’s comfortable. The doctors here are on another level—thorough, knowledgeable, and genuinely invested in my dog’s health.

What stands out most is how consistent they are. Every visit, every phone call, every question—it’s handled with the same professionalism and care. They don’t just treat symptoms; they look at the whole picture and make sure you understand what’s going on. I’ve never felt rushed, and I’ve never left without answers.

Southpaw Vets has earned my complete trust, and that’s not easy when it comes to my dog. I can’t recommend them enough.

I had to say goodbye to my dog recently, and Southpaw Vet helped make that experience feel safe and supported. I am really grateful for my experience with the Southpaw staff during such a difficult time. Dr. Yonas and his team were incredibly kind. They treated me and my dog with care and kindness and gave me the space to say goodbye to my dog without feeling rushed. I felt like we were both in attentive and compassionate hands.

It was a painful day, but I left feeling like I had done right by him. I’m grateful to the team for making something so hard feel a little more human. I sincerely recommend Southpaw Vet to anyone who has a pet, and I’ll be coming back when it’s time to bring a new companion into my family and life.

I brought my senior cat Schmee in for bloodwork and ear treatment – two things she’s never tolerated well, and today was no exception.

Tara and Andrea (best vet techs ever!!) were absolutely amazing. They showed so much compassion and patience with my sensitive girl, taking the time to make sure she felt safe and cared for throughout the visit. You went above and beyond in this situation- Southpaw is lucky to have you.

I was looking around for a new vet when several of my friends recommended SouthPaw. Overall I was very happy with my experience. The staff were so kind to me and my dog. I was also impressed with the aesthetic of the office, it felt very inviting and not clinical at all. Dr. Yonas was so gentle with my dog, and he addressed all of my questions and concerns in detail. Prices were reasonable and the care plan proposal was explained thoroughly. I know that my dog is now in good hands!
Called multiple times and was put on hold endlessly. Waited 8+mins and gave up. Will try again in the future but just a heads up for anyone calling in, may not be a great idea.

Dr. Yonas and staff are absolutely amazing. The support staff is always incredibly fast to reply whether it’s by phone or by text messaging so it’s very convenient to schedule an appointment. Even when the doctors are busy, they will still take care of their patients through any supportive means necessary whether that’s text, email, or even phone calls. I’m so glad that I switched to this clinic after years with another one and not receiving quality medical care for my Critter crew. I will be a Southpaw Vet customer for life! You really can tell that they get to know and get to love your pets and treat them as if they are their own. ❤️

My wife and I have taken our kitten here now for all of his vaccines and check ups and everyone has been great. Especially Jesus, he is so helpful and willing to go the extra mile with reassurance and answering any questions my wife or I have. We really appreciate his hard work.

I absolutely LOVE Southpaw! All the staff is kind, helpful and accommodating. Dr. Skinner is the best vet that I have ever had the pleasure of seeing with a pet.  They go above and beyond. I cannot recommend them enough and I can't say enough positive things.
Best veterinary emergency group ever ! Thank you so much

I can’t recommend Southpaw Vet enough! I take all three of my dogs there, and they always provide great care. One of my dogs, a Belgian Malinois, gets very nervous at the vet, but the team is so patient and gentle with her. Dr. Yonas even took time to sit with her and give her treats to help her feel more comfortable. Today, I had a scare with my dog Ollie, who suddenly developed welts all over his face and body. I rushed him in, unsure if they could see him or if I needed to go to an emergency clinic. Thankfully, one of the vet techs took him right back and handled it quickly. Dr. Yonas then came out to explain a plan for Ollie, and his calm approach really helped me during a stressful moment. Ollie is doing great now, and I’m so relieved they took care of him right away. I feel so confident leaving my dogs in their hands every time!

Seems like they’re more interested in selling you their services in packages than taking care of your pet. They did not even attempt to help set up the following appointment for the necessary vaccines.

This clinic over charges for services and the Vet wasn't very friendly.
We are used to a vet loving on your pet & really showing that they care. We didn't get that here.
They upsell services and are all about the "treatment plan"
We were not pleased.

Both vets are amazing! My little guy is feisty, but this vet's office is the only one that knows how to handle him to calm him down and get the procedure completed. Great location and great staff! Highly recommend.

For the first time ever I’ve found a vet that I really like. The receptionists are nice, it’s easy to make and confirm appointments. The lobby and rooms are clean and not cold or hospital like. I’ve taken my dog when it was her time to go and they were so gentle and caring with her and me. I recently took my cat in for his first visit and they were just as friendly and helpful. The pricing is reasonable and the service has been much better than anyplace I’ve gone before. My cat and I recommend South Paw for all your furry family members needs.
Amazing! The best place for my cats
Very nice place - even better people. starting from the reception everybody perfectly friendly and kind to patients. Love this place and this people.

We used to go to Kensington Vet (where they misdiagnosed our dogs cancer), very overpriced and unprofessional. South Paw was a BREATH OF FRESH AIR!! Both in the interior establishment itself and staff. It’s beautifully decorated, modern and CLEAN without feeling like a hospital and you can tell the owner cares and pays attention to details. The staff know us by name and are extremely knowledgeable, professional and CARE!! They don’t rip you off on normal routine visits and are always up front and honest. I have sent multiple people to them and have never heard a negative experience. Highly recommend!! (And we have a frenchie, so we KNOW our vet 😜 and he LOVES EVELYN!!) Dr Mayne is extremely intelligent and gentle. 😊
Excellent services for pets and owner. Very compassionate. Excellent medical competency.
Fantastic Vet and entire staff!!  We have four dogs and they all get seen here. By far the best veterinarian in San Diego County
Excellent in every way!

Great communication, absolutely special care. These folks love pets and they’ll go the extra mile to make sure your fur baby is cared for. Super clean facility, modern tech, lovely and capable staff. Easy appointments by text.

We haven't been going here for that long but it seems so much more thorough and attentive than the last place we had. They don't rush you, give clear instructions, and even call the day after to follow up on any concerns. You can schedule and upload records online, and they are less expensive than the last place we had some bad/rushed experiences at. They also have some really cute art throughout the whole place! They gave my dog's last round of vaccines with me in the room to help him feel more comfortable and are really friendly with the animals, making them feel comfortable.

Parking can be a little bit tricky if you haven't been there before, but there is free parking underground if you go around to the street on the other side of the building. If you have an EV there are a few charger spots that are often open, making it pretty convenient for us to hit 2 birds with one stone.

It appears they also just purchased/rented additional space next door when (sadly) the taquitos place closed, but I'm excited to see what they add, I'm hoping it could be boarding facilities as that would be super convenient for us!
Staff is super friendly, you can tell they really care about the pets they see.

My dog has been a patient for about a year or two, mostly just for annual checkups and vaccines However, she was recently experiencing some symptoms that I wanted checked out ASAP. I called in the morning and they were able to squeeze me in …
Not sure if we could find a better and more reliable clinic and veterinarian 🫨 thank you for always taking care of us and our little old baby! …
